goal: Upgrade the existing /app/(protected)/map page to render a real interactive Google-like map using Leaflet + react-leaflet while preserving all backend APIs, socket contracts, validation rules, and authentication logic.

map_library.reason: No API key required, lightweight, Google-like experience, mobile friendly

tasks.title: Install and configure Leaflet
steps: Import leaflet CSS globally (in layout or map component)
Fix default marker icon path issue (configure L.Icon.Default if necessary)
tasks.deliverable: Leaflet working without missing marker icon errors

tasks.title: Create reusable DriverMap component
requirements: Render MapContainer full width and height
Accept props: currentDriver, nearbyDrivers, selectedDriverId, onSelectDriver
Render current driver marker with distinct icon
Allow marker click to trigger onSelectDriver(driverId)
Support recentering when selected driver changes
ui_constraints: Height should fill viewport minus navbar

tasks.title: Upgrade map page to use real map
steps: Maintain local state for nearby drivers

tasks.title: Selected driver UI panel
requirements: Panel must be mobile-friendly (bottom sheet or overlay card)

real_time_requirements: Two authenticated users should see each other as live markers
Movement should update marker position in real time
Clicking a marker shows driver info card
Socket listeners must detach on unmount
verification_checklist: Map renders with real OpenStreetMap tiles
Real-time updates work between two browser sessions
stop_condition: Real interactive map renders, live updates work, no backend changes required, no TypeScript or runtime errors.
